from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid-color lines separate equal-sized panels; copy the panel containing
    # the non-background pattern into every other panel.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    div_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in div_colors)
    if not counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def intervals(n, separators):
        spans, start = [], 0
        for x in separators:
            if start < x:
                spans.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        if start < n:
            spans.append((start, n))
        return spans or [(0, n)]
    row_spans = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    # The panel with the most cells differing from the common background is source.
    source = max(((sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)), ri, ci)
                  for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans)
                  for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans)), default=(0, 0, 0))
    _, src_ri, src_ci = source
    sr0, sr1 = row_spans[src_ri]
    sc0, sc1 = col_spans[src_ci]
    motif = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = motif[r-r0][c-c0]
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Uniform lines in a non-background color partition the grid into panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def intervals(n, separators):
        spans, start = [], 0
        for x in separators:
            if start < x:
                spans.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        if start < n:
            spans.append((start, n))
        return spans or [(0, n)]
    row_spans = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    # Pick the panel with the most non-background cells, then copy its pattern
    # into each panel while preserving the divider lines.
    _, src_ri, src_ci = max(
        (sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)), ri, ci)
        for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans)
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans)
    )
    sr0, sr1 = row_spans[src_ri]
    sc0, sc1 = col_spans[src_ci]
    motif = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            if (ri, ci) == (src_ri, src_ci):
                continue
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = motif[r - r0][c - c0]
    return out
PY
